evals.prompt: Review a mobile map demo that uses 100vh, a draggable bottom sheet, 36px controls, and animated camera transitions.
evals.expected_output: The review identifies dynamic viewport, safe-area, touch-target, gesture, panel-scroll, and reduced-motion requirements.
expectations: Requires 100svh or 100dvh rather than assuming 100vh is stable on mobile.
Requires at least 44x44 CSS pixel hit areas and safe-area padding.
Checks that bottom-sheet drag, page scroll, and map gestures do not conflict.
Requires a reduced-motion camera path and rendered narrow-viewport evidence.

evals.prompt: A responsive interaction pass approves hover, focus, and active screenshots one at a time. Review the verification plan.
evals.expected_output: The review requires related interaction states to be rendered together across schemes and viewports.
expectations: Requires hover, focus, and active to remain visually distinguishable.
Requires light and dark scheme checks at narrow and wide viewports.
Does not accept isolated screenshots as sufficient evidence.
